Need be careful.

We need decide story by story. Role and means. Most user story format "As a [role], I want [functionality], so that [benefit]". But some malformed or missing means/role? Need inspect.

We need consider "core story text" includes role and means. They all mostly have As a/I want. Violation when either role or functionality cannot be identified. Even if grammar weird, can we identify role and means? For role, maybe "anonymoususer", "authenticateduser", "trainingcoordinator" etc are role despite no space? Yes role identifiable. Means is "I want to ..." usually. Need evaluate.

Need avoid penalize other criteria. Well-formed only requires role and means. Example "anonymoususer" still role? It is one word, but identifiable stakeholder role. So No Violation for role. Means: requested functionality. Some stories maybe missing means? Let's inspect all.
